name: Merriod
description: A hulking shark-like predator whose elongated appendages end in snapping secondary mouths. It seizes prey from a distance and drags them toward its enormous central jaws.

abilities.name: Twin Maws
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack roll (+2) against up to two different targets within Very Close range. On a success, each target takes 2d6+3 physical damage.

abilities.name: Hook and Haul
abilities.description: Make an attack roll (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+3 physical damage, pull the target into Melee range, and make them Restrained in one of the Merriod's secondary maws. They can escape with a successful Strength or Agility Roll (15).

abilities.name: Feeding Bite
abilities.description: Target a creature Restrained by the Merriod and make an attack roll (+2). On a success, deal 2d12+4 physical damage and end the Restrained condition.

abilities.name: Blood in the Water
abilities.description: When a PC within Close range marks 2 or more HP, the Merriod can mark a Stress to immediately move into Very Close range of them. This movement does not grant an attack.
